title: Does Better Retrieval Mean Better Answers? Code, model outputs and annotations
description: Code, configurations, retrieval runs, model outputs and human annotations for the paper 'Does Better Retrieval Mean Better Answers? Selecting Retrievers for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering over a COVID-19 Scholarly Collection'. The study compares five retrieval pipelines (BM25, BGE, MedCPT, reciprocal rank fusion, and fusion with cross-encoder re-ranking) on TREC-COVID and as the retrieval stage of retrieval-augmented question answering over COVID-QA with two open-weight readers (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct).
